summary: V495 lets a Null-consensus subnet run up to 16 mechanisms: MaxAllowedUids may be up to 2500 for any mechanism count, while Yuma keeps its limit of 256 for max UIDs times mechanism count. The global mechanism maximum stays at two until root raises it. A new Null weight row holds at most 2500 divided by the mechanism count entries, at least one; the new error is TooManyWeightsForNullMechanism. The Null epoch reads subnet-wide state once instead of once per mechanism, with identical results, and adds an interim weight to the block hook. A gamma deposit that gamma emission opens has no daily spend cap; existing deposits keep theirs and no migration runs. Spec version 495 with unchanged transaction version 2 requires signers and indexers to refresh metadata. The release guide covers releases 494 and 495 together, with CLI, Python SDK, and raw extrinsic examples, mechanism guides, compatibility notes, accepted risks, and possible sudo calls.
